
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/23241322" title="发布于 2026-10-09 17:44">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【App Service】为应用服务添加Key Vault证书时遇见的RBAC问题之两个困扰人的坑</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>问题描述</h1>
<p>为了安全，需要为App Service访问添加HTTPS证书。</p>
<p>为了更加安全，需要把证书放在Key Vault的证书中进行保存。</p>
<p>为了更加更加安全，App Service访问Key Vault中的证书时候，需要通过RBAC访问，替代了Key Vault中之前的Access Policy方式。</p>
<p>为了以上的三重安全，使用RBAC导入证书的时候，需要遇见两个困扰人的大坑。</p>
<p><strong>坑一：</strong>在门户上操作App Service Add Certficates时，无法加载Key Vault中的证书列表以供选择。</p>
<p>报错：The operation is not allowed by RBAC. If role assignments were recently changed, please wait several minutes for role assignments to become effective.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>坑二：</strong>当上一个坑解决后，当点击Add后，依旧出现无权限访问问题。</p>
<p>报错：The service does not have access to '/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourcegroups/00-000-00/providers/microsoft.keyvault/vaults/0000000' Key Vault. Please make sure that you have granted necessary permissions to the service to perform the request operation.</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="478" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202610/2127802-20261009173306294-2010681714.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>问题解答</h2>
<p>以上两个坑，都是RBAC之后的权限问题。</p>
<p>只是从直观的错误信息上，无法得出具体的错误信息。如果需要查看详细的错误消息，必须开启Key Vault的诊断日志。</p>
<p>如把Key Vault的诊断日志开启之后，以上两个坑的详细错误就可以从 【 AzureDiagnostics&nbsp;| where ResultSignature == "Forbidden"&nbsp;| distinct ResultDescription 】中得到具体是哪一个Application ID无法访问，是缺少什么权限的问题。</p>
<p>比如以上两个坑的Key Vault Audit日志显示：</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="400" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202610/2127802-20261009172558187-2041202370.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>当得到详细的错误信息后，就非常容易解决这个权限(Forbidden)问题。分别为当前登录的用户添加”<strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Key Vault Certificate User</span></strong>“权限和为"<strong>Microsoft.Azure.WebSites</strong>" 添加&nbsp;"<strong>Key Vault Secrets User</strong>" 权限。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>最后总结</h1>
<p>要想成功配置RBAC认证方式，从App Service加载Key Vault证书，需要如下三个赋权步骤（均在Azure Key Vault的Access Control页面完成）：</p>
<p>1：为这个App Service的Identity添加”<strong>Key Vault Certificate User</strong>“权限。</p>
<p>2：为当前登录Azure页面的用户添加”<strong>Key Vault Certificate User</strong>“权限。</p>
<p>3：为"<strong>Microsoft.Azure.WebSites</strong>" 添加 "<strong>Key Vault Secrets User</strong>" 权限。注：第三个权限与前两个不一样。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="384" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202610/2127802-20261009173744529-333672520.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
